nodes_add.name: Bhagavan Das
nodes_add.note: American seeker in India who introduced Alpert to Neem Karoli Baba in 1967 (Wikipedia, Ram Dass; Be Here Now title phrase came from his remark).

nodes_add.name: Baba Hari Dass
nodes_add.note: Ram Dass's sadhana tutor; Neem Karoli Baba asked for changes to passages about him in Be Here Now (Wikipedia, Be Here Now).

nodes_update.name: Ram Dass
nodes_update.note: Born Richard Alpert, Boston, 6 Apr 1931; Harvard dismissed 1963; met Neem Karoli Baba 1967; Be Here Now (1971); Hanuman Foundation 1974; Seva Foundation 1978; stroke Feb 1997; d. Maui 22 Dec 2019.

edges_upsert.note: Introduced him to Neem Karoli Baba in 1967 (Wikipedia); supplied the phrase that became the book's title.
Explored Buddhist meditation in several schools from 1968 (InsightLA).

places.name: Lama Foundation, San Cristobal
places.what: From Bindu to Ojas circulated here in 1970; Be Here Now published 1971

issues: ram-dass: Sources are Wikipedia (Ram Dass; Be Here Now), a wire obituary carried by KMPH, and InsightLA. Be Here Now and Miracle of Love were not read. Wikipedia's statement that he studied with Neem Karoli Baba about four years (1967-71) was left out because the guru died in 1973 and the dates do not sit together. Obituary and Wikipedia agree on the Harvard dismissal in 1963 (the obituary says over experiments with hallucinogens); the Harvard drug research is mentioned only as biography. The dating of Hari Dass edge (1968) is approximate. Stroke 1997 and aphasia are from Wikipedia and are personal-life facts bearing on the teaching.
